verdict.rationale: Okta documents its own Admin Management APIs, exposed through an official MCP server, and says it can be used to manage and automate Okta. Examples include creating users, adding users to groups, querying failed logins and listing unused apps. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows that the API matches everything the UI can do, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec at the standard paths to check coverage. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, a complete API reference or OpenAPI spec showing full admin coverage, and independent or hands-on confirmation that UI-only gaps don't exist.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
